title: Product Analyst
company: Visa Consolidated Support Services (India) Private Limited - Tech Unit
description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. The team focuses on providing reliable, secure, and reusable platform capabilities that support the full AI/ML lifecycle - from data and feature enablement to model training, deployment, monitoring, and optimization. The team partners closely with engineering, data science, product, and business teams to ensure AI capabilities can be delivered efficiently and responsibly across multiple use cases, including fraud, risk, authorization, and ecosystem protection. We are seeking a hands‑on Product Analyst with experience across AI/ML platforms, data‑driven product development, and GenAI prototyping. This role is ideal for someone who is technically grounded, product‑oriented, and adaptable, and can work across multiple problem spaces as priorities evolve. Key Responsibilities: Drive and support product requirements for AI/ML and Generative AI platform capabilities, partnering closely with engineering, data science, and MLOps teams. Translate business, data science, and platform needs into well-defined features, user stories, technical requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria. Contribute to platform capabilities across AI/ML lifecycle management, Generative AI enablement, feature engineering and feature platforms, developer tooling, and observability. Develop a strong understanding of end-to-end AI/ML workflows, including data preparation, feature engineering, model development, inference, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Apply hands-on technical skills using Python, SQL, APIs, notebooks, and AI/ML tools to analyze data, validate solutions, troubleshoot issues, and develop prototypes. Support Generative AI capabilities involving Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, embeddings, evaluation, and agentic AI patterns, working with engineering teams to translate prototypes and use cases into scalable platform capabilities. Work with technologies such as Databricks and cloud environments to understand AI/ML workloads and incorporate relevant technical considerations into product requirements and solution trade-offs. Develop an understanding of feature engineering and feature platforms, including how features are computed, transformed, stored, discovered, reused, and consumed by AI/ML applications. Understand large-scale data processing across cloud and on-premises environments, including batch and real-time/streaming workloads, as they relate to AI/ML platform capabilities. Conduct product and technical acceptance validation prior to release and support successful adoption of AI/ML platform capabilities by user and stakeholder teams. Collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, Data Science, MLOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Governance teams within an Agile environment to accelerate delivery and time-to-market. Own assigned platform initiatives from requirements definition through delivery, release, and post-launch validation. Create and maintain product and technical documentation, including requirements, workflows, release notes, technical guidance, FAQs, and runbooks, to support stakeholders and platform adoption. Remain flexible and adaptable, supporting multiple product initiatives and evolving AI/ML platform priorities. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Preferred Qualifications: 2+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Analysis, Technical Product Management, Business Analysis, AI/ML platforms, software development, data science/engineering, or a related technical role. Good understanding of AI/ML concepts and the model lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model development, inference, deployment, and monitoring. Understanding of Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, embeddings, evaluation approaches, and agentic AI. Hands-on experience with Python and/or SQL for data analysis, automation, prototyping, or AI/ML use cases. Exposure to Databricks and/or cloud environments AI/ML workloads. Understanding of large-scale data processing concepts, including batch and real-time/streaming processing in support of AI/ML use cases. Exposure to feature engineering and feature platforms/stores, with an understanding of how ML features are created, managed, discovered, reused, and consumed. Hands-on exposure to Generative AI technologies such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, or equivalent technologies, through professional work, academic projects, or prototypes. Familiarity with MLOps, model and platform monitoring, observability, or production support is desirable. Familiarity with software development lifecycle methodologies, Git/version control, Agile delivery models, and Scrum-based development teams. Experience working with cross-functional teams to launch and support technical products or AI/ML platform capabilities within complex organizations. Exposure to payments, fraud, risk management, decisioning systems, or real-time AI/ML systems is highly desirable. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. title: Technical Analyst
description: Shape the future of work in complex industries. At Falkor, we help some of the world's most complex industries operate with greater clarity, confidence, and control. Built on more than 200 years of KONGSBERG industrial heritage, our industrial intelligence platform connects people, systems, and workflows across energy, processing, power, renewables, and other heavy-asset industries. We turn complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance across the asset lifecycle. As industries evolve, we're building the technology that helps people see further, decide faster, and operate with confidence. The Opportunity Falkor is seeking a Technical Analyst to join the Customer Support team. This hands-on role is suited to candidates with 0–4 years of experience in application, technical, or product support and troubleshooting for internal or external customers. You will install, configure, implement, and support real-time systems and applications for the oil and gas industry. Working directly with customers and collaborating with internal teams, you will troubleshoot technical issues, support reliable application operation, and deliver timely, customer-focused resolutions. The role requires rotational day and night shifts in India and travel to client offices when required. Every Technical Analyst will have the opportunity to learn and support all products across Falkor’s portfolio, including SiteCom, LedaFlow, K-Spice, Falkor Platform, and Falkor Surface. Primary product assignments will be aligned to each analyst’s best fit, considering their technical strengths, domain knowledge, and interests, while maintaining opportunities to build expertise and contribute across the portfolio. SiteCom: Real-time drilling data management. LedaFlow: Transient multiphase flow simulation and flow assurance in wells and pipelines. K-Spice: Dynamic process simulation for engineering design, verification, optimisation, and operator training. Falkor Platform: Industrial data integration and contextualisation, providing a connected foundation for applications, simulation, and AI. Falkor Surface: A shared operational workspace connecting people, data, simulation, and AI agents for collaboration and decision support. What You'll Do: Key Responsibilities- Customer Support and Application Operations Install, configure, implement, and support Falkor applications across real-time drilling data, flow and process simulation, industrial data integration, and operational collaboration, in line with assigned responsibilities. Handle customer support requests over email and phone, troubleshooting and resolving issues on installed systems in a timely manner. Use knowledge of each customer’s environment to deliver high-quality incident resolution, with a focus on identifying root causes. SiteCom: Support real-time drilling data availability and WITSML data exchange; investigate data access, connectivity, and data-quality issues affecting customer workflows. LedaFlow: Assist users with application setup, simulation case execution, and access to results for multiphase flow and flow-assurance studies; capture reproducible issues for specialist investigation. K-Spice: Support application configuration and the operation of dynamic process simulation and operator-training environments; investigate simulation execution and integration issues with the relevant specialists. Falkor Platform: Support data-source connectivity, ingestion, contextualisation, and access to industrial data; investigate reported data availability and integration issues. Falkor Surface: Help users access and navigate operational workspaces, search and visualise asset information, and use collaboration features; troubleshoot access, display, and workflow issues. Customer Enablement and Delivery Support Work with clients to configure and support SiteCom real-time data workflows and WITSML integrations for drilling environments. Support deployment and configuration of applicable Falkor applications. Collaborate with customers and internal teams to clarify technical requirements and resolve application issues. Assist customers with onboarding and initial setup across simulation, data-platform, and operational-workspace products, coordinating with delivery and product specialists as required. Help validate data connections and access in Falkor Platform, asset information and workspace configuration in Falkor Surface, and simulation environment readiness for LedaFlow and K-Spice. SLA Management and Support Operations Manage support requests in line with defined service-level agreements, incident priorities, and support procedures. Provide clear, timely updates to customers throughout troubleshooting and resolution. Maintain accurate incident records, troubleshooting notes, and shift handovers to support continuity of service. Technical Troubleshooting and Escalation Investigate application, Windows Server, network connectivity, configuration, and data-related issues across supported customer environments, distinguishing technical faults from matters requiring product or domain expertise. Apply knowledge of SQL, NoSQL, and flat-file databases to investigate issues in supported customer environments. Escalate complex issues to the appropriate internal teams with relevant context, diagnostic information, and troubleshooting steps already completed. Collect product-relevant diagnostics, such as SiteCom data-flow examples, LedaFlow and K-Spice simulation cases and execution logs, Falkor Platform ingestion and integration details, and Falkor Surface reproduction steps and affected views. Investigate automated alerts received for issues lying with the data quality, pipelines, asset and/or system health. Coordinate with product and domain specialists on simulation-model behaviour, flow-assurance questions, process-engineering issues, and complex data or workflow configurations; validate fixes and workarounds before confirming resolution. Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and root cause findings for reuse by the support team. Identify recurring issues and contribute to improvements in support documentation and processes. Build working knowledge across SiteCom, LedaFlow, K-Spice, Falkor Platform, and Falkor Surface through product learning and cross-team knowledge sharing, while developing deeper expertise in best-fit product assignments. Maintain product-specific troubleshooting guides covering recurring data-flow, simulation execution, integration, access, and workspace issues. Shift-Based Support Coverage Work rotational shifts in alignment with Customer Support coverage requirements and business needs. Provide weekend coverage when assigned, ensuring timely handovers and continuity of service. Provide clear handovers identifying the affected product, customer impact, troubleshooting completed, outstanding actions, and any specialist escalation needed to maintain continuity across shifts. Travel to client offices when required and work effectively with customers and colleagues across cultures. What We're Looking For: 0–2 years of experience in application, technical, or product support, including troubleshooting for internal or external customers over email and phone. Bachelor’s degree in petroleum engineering or computer science. Experience deploying, configuring, or supporting .NET applications or software on staging and production servers. Windows Server system administration experience and knowledge of network communication solutions. Knowledge of well construction processes, drilling workflows, drilling performance analytics, and standard operating practices in the oil and gas industry. Working knowledge and experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, and JSON. A proactive, customer-friendly approach, a commitment to on-time delivery, and strong troubleshooting skills. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team, including with people from different cultures. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Willingness to work rotational day and night shifts in India and travel to client offices when required. Desirable Experience Familiarity with WITSML or WITS. Experience working on a drilling rig; beneficial but not mandatory. Experience administering SaaS solutions on Microsoft Azure. Knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC). Success Measures Technical support issues are resolved promptly and effectively, with clear customer communication. Root cause findings and resolutions are documented accurately and made available for reuse. Deployments, configurations, and customer-specific solutions meet agreed requirements. Shift handovers and support records enable continuity of service. Recurring issues are identified and support knowledge and processes improve over time. Why join Falkor? You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate. At Falkor, you'll have the opportunity to: Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work. About Falkor Falkor is a KONGSBERG company that enables organizations in heavy-asset industries to expand human capability and redefine how assets are designed, operated, and optimized across their lifecycle. By connecting people, systems, and workflows, Falkor's industrial intelligence platform turns complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping leading organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance. Ready to apply? If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today with your resume.

title: Data Science Analyst
description: JOB DESCRIPTION At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. # About the team and the role **The Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C) team** focuses on making selling on eBay simple, fast, and rewarding for everyday sellers, from listing and shipping to getting paid and selling again. C2C is a key growth engine for eBay: it brings unique inventory to the marketplace, and sellers who also buy drive significantly more demand across the platform. The team works to grow and retain the C2C seller base, improve selling velocity, and strengthen this buyer–seller flywheel. **In this role** in the Indian Analytics Centre, you will be a hands-on analytics partner for C2C product initiatives. You will take well-scoped and moderately ambiguous product questions, break them down into clear analyses, and turn your findings into crisp insights and recommendations. Working closely with senior analysts and the analytics manager, you will build strong product and data depth in C2C and grow towards independently owning larger problem spaces. The role suits someone who is curious, self-driven, and eager to take ownership of their work. # What you will accomplish Own analytics for defined C2C workstreams Measure how C2C product changes move core outcomes such as seller growth, listings, sold items, and incremental GMV, and help identify the levers that make C2C sellers more successful. Break down product and business questions into structured analyses with clear hypotheses and success metrics, with guidance on scoping for broader or more ambiguous problems. Use strong SQL and analytical rigour to analyse customer behaviour, product performance, feature adoption, funnels, and cohorts across large datasets. Turn analysis into clear, well-structured insights and recommendations for product managers and working teams, and contribute to narratives shared with senior stakeholders. Partner with product, engineering, design, and peer analytics teams on day-to-day questions, and keep stakeholders informed on progress, findings, and risks. Support measurement for product tests and launches, including defining metrics, building dashboards, monitoring performance, and diagnosing changes. Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reporting that enable consistent performance tracking and self-service. Look beyond the immediate ask, flag anomalies, emerging trends, and opportunities in the data, and bring them to the team with a point of view. Maintain high analytical quality by following clear metric definitions, validating data, documenting assumptions, and having work reviewed before it is shared. # What you will bring ## Required qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent practical experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative field. 2–4 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related role, ideally in a product or consumer technology setting. Strong hands-on SQL skills and experience analysing large, imperfect datasets with accuracy and attention to detail. Experience in product or business analytics, such as funnel analysis, customer journey analysis, feature adoption, segmentation, or performance measurement. Ability to build clear, user-friendly dashboards and data visualisations using BI or analytics tools. Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals and experiment measurement. Good critical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to question assumptions and understand the real question behind an ask. Ability to communicate findings clearly in writing and verbally, and to present analysis confidently to product and cross-functional partners. Self-driven and proactive working style, with a strong sense of ownership and the willingness to ask questions, raise issues, and move work forward. Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high standards for data quality and timely delivery. description: JOB DESCRIPTION At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. # About the team and the role **The Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C) team** focuses on making selling on eBay simple, fast, and rewarding for everyday sellers, from listing and shipping to getting paid and selling again. C2C is a key growth engine for eBay: it brings unique inventory to the marketplace, and sellers who also buy drive significantly more demand across the platform. The team works to grow and retain the C2C seller base, improve selling velocity, and strengthen this buyer–seller flywheel. **In this role** in the Indian Analytics Centre, you will be a hands-on analytics partner for C2C product initiatives. You will take well-scoped and moderately ambiguous product questions, break them down into clear analyses, and turn your findings into crisp insights and recommendations. Working closely with senior analysts and the analytics manager, you will build strong product and data depth in C2C and grow towards independently owning larger problem spaces. The role suits someone who is curious, self-driven, and eager to take ownership of their work. # What you will accomplish Own analytics for defined C2C workstreams Measure how C2C product changes move core outcomes such as seller growth, listings, sold items, and incremental GMV, and help identify the levers that make C2C sellers more successful. Break down product and business questions into structured analyses with clear hypotheses and success metrics, with guidance on scoping for broader or more ambiguous problems. Use strong SQL and analytical rigour to analyse customer behaviour, product performance, feature adoption, funnels, and cohorts across large datasets. Turn analysis into clear, well-structured insights and recommendations for product managers and working teams, and contribute to narratives shared with senior stakeholders. Partner with product, engineering, design, and peer analytics teams on day-to-day questions, and keep stakeholders informed on progress, findings, and risks. Support measurement for product tests and launches, including defining metrics, building dashboards, monitoring performance, and diagnosing changes. Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reporting that enable consistent performance tracking and self-service. Look beyond the immediate ask, flag anomalies, emerging trends, and opportunities in the data, and bring them to the team with a point of view. Maintain high analytical quality by following clear metric definitions, validating data, documenting assumptions, and having work reviewed before it is shared. # What you will bring ## Required qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent practical experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative field. 2–4 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related role, ideally in a product or consumer technology setting. Strong hands-on SQL skills and experience analysing large, imperfect datasets with accuracy and attention to detail. Experience in product or business analytics, such as funnel analysis, customer journey analysis, feature adoption, segmentation, or performance measurement. Ability to build clear, user-friendly dashboards and data visualisations using BI or analytics tools. Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals and experiment measurement. Good critical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to question assumptions and understand the real question behind an ask. Ability to communicate findings clearly in writing and verbally, and to present analysis confidently to product and cross-functional partners. Self-driven and proactive working style, with a strong sense of ownership and the willingness to ask questions, raise issues, and move work forward. Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high standards for data quality and timely delivery. An AI-first mindset and interest in using AI-enabled tools to improve analytical productivity and synthesis. ## Good to have Working knowledge of Python for exploratory analysis, automation, or prototyping. Exposure to causal inference or quasi-experimental methods. Experience with product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar tools. Experience in e-commerce, online marketplaces, seller or creator platforms, or consumer technology. Additional Details eBay is an equal opportunity employer. Our collaborative, inclusive, and forward-looking culture empowers professionals to grow and make a tangible impact across one of the world’s leading financial institutions. The AIM Cards & Wealth organization acts as the strategic intelligence engine across our credit card portfolios and wealth management franchises. We power customer acquisition, card spend stimulation, portfolio deepening, and wealth advisory insights. We actively integrate modern data architectures, customer analytics, and Generative AI productivity frameworks into our day-to-day operations to deliver hyper-relevant business insights, actionable customer intelligence, and optimized strategies for our cardholders and affluent wealth clients. In this role, you will be the analytical owner and insight lead across Credit Card products (Acquisition, Spend Stimulation, Revolving, Balance Transfer, Loyalty/Rewards) and Wealth Management offerings (Investment Products, Wealth Advisory, Mortgages, FX, Time Deposits, and Digital Banking). Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to present and defend insights. Ability to work independently, demonstrate resourcefulness and take complete ownership in a lean, entrepreneurial environment. title: Data Science Analyst
description: At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. # About the team and the role The Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C) team** focuses on making selling on eBay simple, fast, and rewarding for everyday sellers, from listing and shipping to getting paid and selling again. C2C is a key growth engine for eBay: it brings unique inventory to the marketplace, and sellers who also buy drive significantly more demand across the platform. The team works to grow and retain the C2C seller base, improve selling velocity, and strengthen this buyer–seller flywheel. In this role** in the Indian Analytics Centre, you will be a hands-on analytics partner for C2C product initiatives. You will take well-scoped and moderately ambiguous product questions, break them down into clear analyses, and turn your findings into crisp insights and recommendations. Working closely with senior analysts and the analytics manager, you will build strong product and data depth in C2C and grow towards independently owning larger problem spaces. The role suits someone who is curious, self-driven, and eager to take ownership of their work. # What you will accomplish Own analytics for defined C2C workstreams Measure how C2C product changes move core outcomes such as seller growth, listings, sold items, and incremental GMV, and help identify the levers that make C2C sellers more successful. Break down product and business questions into structured analyses with clear hypotheses and success metrics, with guidance on scoping for broader or more ambiguous problems. Use strong SQL and analytical rigour to analyse customer behaviour, product performance, feature adoption, funnels, and cohorts across large datasets. Turn analysis into clear, well-structured insights and recommendations for product managers and working teams, and contribute to narratives shared with senior stakeholders. Partner with product, engineering, design, and peer analytics teams on day-to-day questions, and keep stakeholders informed on progress, findings, and risks. Support measurement for product tests and launches, including defining metrics, building dashboards, monitoring performance, and diagnosing changes. Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reporting that enable consistent performance tracking and self-service. Look beyond the immediate ask, flag anomalies, emerging trends, and opportunities in the data, and bring them to the team with a point of view. Maintain high analytical quality by following clear metric definitions, validating data, documenting assumptions, and having work reviewed before it is shared. # What you will bring ## Required qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent practical experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative field. 2–4 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related role, ideally in a product or consumer technology setting. Strong hands-on SQL skills and experience analysing large, imperfect datasets with accuracy and attention to detail. Experience in product or business analytics, such as funnel analysis, customer journey analysis, feature adoption, segmentation, or performance measurement. Ability to build clear, user-friendly dashboards and data visualisations using BI or analytics tools. Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals and experiment measurement. Good critical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to question assumptions and understand the real question behind an ask. Ability to communicate findings clearly in writing and verbally, and to present analysis confidently to product and cross-functional partners. Self-driven and proactive working style, with a strong sense of ownership and the willingness to ask questions, raise issues, and move work forward. Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high standards for data quality and timely delivery. An AI-first mindset and interest in using AI-enabled tools to improve analytical productivity and synthesis. ## Good to have Working knowledge of Python for exploratory analysis, automation, or prototyping. Exposure to causal inference or quasi-experimental methods. Experience with product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar tools. Experience in e-commerce, online marketplaces, seller or creator platforms, or consumer technology. Additional Details eBay is an equal opportunity employer. title: Data Analyst II, Tech - Data
description: About The Role And Team We’re looking for a Data Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with data product management capabilities to help develop and scale our Customer Support data product portfolio. You will independently lead a defined data product area, from understanding stakeholder needs and prioritizing opportunities through requirements, validation, launch, and adoption. You will investigate data directly, make recommendations, align stakeholders, and work with technical partners to deliver reusable solutions. This is a hands-on individual contributor role requiring strong SQL, product judgment, and cross-functional execution. You will be expected to use AI tools consistently to accelerate data exploration, SQL development, documentation, and validation, and to develop repeatable workflows that improve the team’s productivity and quality. The Customer Support Data Product team builds trusted, reusable data foundations for analytics, reporting, and AI. We translate business and product needs into well-defined datasets, consistent metrics, and data capabilities that support better decisions and customer experiences. Data Product owns consumer needs, prioritization, business definitions, requirements, acceptance criteria, and adoption. We partner closely with Data Solutions, which owns technical architecture and implementation, and Data Operations, which owns production support. What You’ll Do Own a defined data product area. Understand consumer needs, identify gaps, and maintain a prioritized backlog aligned with the team’s portfolio strategy. Recommend investments and sequencing based on business value, reuse potential, dependencies, and effort. Lead discovery and define outcomes. Translate ambiguous requests into clear problem statements, use cases, success measures, and delivery scope. Challenge assumptions and identify opportunities to address shared needs across consumers. Write actionable data product specifications. Define entities, dataset grain, attributes, relationships, metric logic, business rules, source-to-target expectations, downstream integration needs, and acceptance criteria. Establish launch data readiness. Review product requirements, define instrumentation and downstream data needs, identify dependencies, and drive validation so priority launches have reliable data available from day one. Investigate data using SQL. Explore source systems, assess feasibility and quality, reconcile discrepancies, and validate transformations and business logic in partnership with Data Solutions. Drive delivery and acceptance. Resolve requirement gaps, align stakeholders on trade-offs, track dependencies, and coordinate user acceptance testing. Confirm that delivered products meet agreed requirements and intended consumer needs. Build foundations for analytics and AI. Define consistent metrics, business context, metadata, and usage constraints so people and AI applications can interpret and use data appropriately. Advance modernization and adoption. Identify fragmented datasets and duplicated reporting logic, define migration requirements, validate continuity, and help consumers transition to centrally supported data products. Verify quality and measure impact. Establish repeatable checks for AI-assisted outputs. Track data product adoption, consumer feedback, and improvements in quality, turnaround time, and manual effort. Basic Qualifications 5+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data products, or a related field. Strong SQL skills, including experience querying complex datasets, investigating discrepancies, and validating joins, transformations, and metric calculations. Demonstrated ability to independently lead a data initiative from an ambiguous business need through delivery and adoption. Experience applying product management practices, including consumer discovery, prioritization, scope definition, stakeholder alignment, and success measurement. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain recommendations and trade-offs to technical and business stakeholders. title: Data Analyst
description: About The Company Who are we? Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary. We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit. Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in. We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us. From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us. Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities. The Role The Customer Experience (CX) charter at Myntra is dedicated to removing friction from the user journey—from app launch to post-delivery support. As a Data Analyst for the CX team, you will be the analytical engine driving our understanding of customer behavior, pain points, and satisfaction metrics. You will translate complex datasets into clear, actionable strategies that directly influence product roadmaps and business operations. Key Responsibilities Data Analytics and Insights: Dive deep into customer interaction data (NPS, CSAT, app drop-offs, and support tickets) to identify root causes of customer friction. Translate raw data into actionable insights that guide CX improvements. Predictive Trend Analysis: Build models to forecast customer behavior, return rates, and seasonal ticket volumes. Anticipate CX challenges before they occur to help operations and product teams stay ahead of the curve. Visual Intelligence: Design and maintain intuitive, high-impact dashboards (via Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker) that track core CX metrics. Make complex data easily consumable for leadership and cross-functional teams. Market Intelligence: Monitor industry benchmarks and competitor CX strategies. Identify gaps and opportunities to ensure Myntra remains the gold standard for e-commerce customer experience in India. Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary data partner for CX leaders. Effectively communicate findings, influence strategic decisions, and align analytical outputs with operational realities. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Support teams to deploy data-backed solutions and track the efficacy of new feature rollouts. Required Skills & Qualifications We Are Looking For a Candidate Who Demonstrates a Strong Baseline (minimum 2 Years Of Applied Experience Or a Solid Level 2 Proficiency) Across The Following Core Competencies Data Analytics and Insights (2): Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and advanced Excel. Strong ability to extract, clean, and interpret large datasets to solve ambiguous problems. Visual Intelligence (2): Hands-on experience with BI tools. Ability to design dashboards that tell a compelling story rather than just displaying numbers. Predictive Trend Analysis (2): Experience working with statistical methods, forecasting, and basic machine learning concepts to predict customer trends. Market Intelligence (2): Familiarity with e-commerce market dynamics, consumer behavior research, and competitive benchmarking. Business Acumen (2): Strong understanding of how CX metrics (like retention and lifetime value) directly impact the bottom line. Ability to balance customer delight with business profitability. Stakeholder Management (2) & Collaboration (2): Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proven ability to translate technical findings for non-technical audiences and drive alignment across diverse teams. Required Skills data analytics, visual intelligence, market intelligence

title: Principal Data Analyst
description: About The Company A US-headquartered life insurance technology company on a mission to make life insurance simple and accessible. Its platform serves consumers, agents and carriers with instant, online products that replace medical exams with a few health questions. The company is data-driven to its core and is building out its analytics function in Bengaluru. About The Role We are hiring a Principal Data Analyst to own and drive the data foundations and self-serve analytics strategy for the whole company. You will design and maintain the systems, models and tools that serve as the single source of truth for funnels, experiments and core business metrics, and you will make it possible for teams across the business to answer their own questions without waiting on an analyst. This is a single opening reporting to a US-based Senior Director of Analytics (Consumer). The role sits at the bridge between data engineering and product analytics: you set the direction for how data is modelled, monitored and consumed, and you also build, validate and ship. You will partner with product, engineering and business leaders in both India and the US. What You Will Do Data foundations: design, build and validate event-based foundational data models that are the single source of truth for funnels, experiments and core business metrics. Self-serve enablement: build scalable datasets, dashboards and monitoring in tools like Amplitude and Mode so that teams can self-serve insights. AI integration: identify and ship AI-driven capabilities that make analytics faster, more discoverable and less dependent on manual analyst support. Reliability and trust: establish monitoring, alerting and documentation so every core metric is accurate, consistent and reliable. End-to-end ownership: scope, design, build, validate and deploy analytics solutions, from raw data pipelines through executive-facing dashboards. Adoption and impact: partner with stakeholders to understand their top use cases, deliver clean metrics and datasets, and drive broad adoption of self-serve tools. Vision and strategy: anticipate future needs, identify gaps and define scalable solutions that raise the bar for the analytics function. Work day to day with US-based analytics leadership, with some overlap with US hours for key syncs. What We Are Looking For Must have 8+ years building and scaling data models, pipelines and self-serve analytics systems; 10+ years ideal. Both halves of the job: strong data architecture and modelling skills, and strong business and analytics stakeholder skills. You can design the warehouse layer and you can turn a product leader’s question into a metric they trust. Expert-level SQL and hands-on experience with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework. Hands-on experience with BI and self-serve tools such as Amplitude, Mode or Looker. Deep understanding of event-based data modelling and instrumentation best practices (event taxonomy, tracking plans, funnel and experiment models). Strong experience building monitoring and alerting for data reliability. A proven track record of driving adoption of self-serve analytics across teams, with measurable outcomes. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders. A high bar for data quality and accuracy; detail-oriented with strong validation practices. Background in a scaled consumer, fintech or product company where you owned the data foundations for high-volume product or growth analytics. Strong plus Experience applying AI or ML tools to analytics workflows (LLM-assisted querying, semantic layers, automated insight discovery, anomaly detection). Experience with experimentation platforms and A/B testing data models. Exposure to insurance, lending or other regulated financial products. Prior experience working with US-based or distributed teams. Who This Role Suits A senior individual contributor who leads through craft and influence rather than headcount. Seasoned Staff or Principal analysts and analytics engineers are the natural fit. Current managers are welcome if they are deliberately moving back to hands-on IC leadership and have kept their technical depth current. Interview process Five rounds, all virtual unless agreed otherwise: hiring manager round, technical deep dive, two stakeholder interviews, culture fit Skills: ai in analytics,data modeling,data architecture,sql,self-serve,product analytics,dbt
